title: Crestline Fleet Account Remittance Channel Points
content:
How a business pays its Crestline Fleet Account invoice moves its early-pay rate, the percent at which the early-pay discount is figured on an invoice that earns it. Remittance channel points are added to the early-pay rate.

## Points by remittance reference

| The remittance reference carries | Remittance channel points |
|---|---|
| ACH or WIRE, whether or not it also carries CHK | 0.25 |
| CHK, and neither ACH nor WIRE | minus 0.25 |
| none of them | none |

The reference read is the payment reference of the most recent remittance applied to the invoice.

## Reading the references (hypothetical)

| Reference | Points |
|---|---|
| carries WIRE only | 0.25 |
| carries ACH and CHK | 0.25 |
| carries CHK only | minus 0.25 |
| carries none of ACH, WIRE or CHK | none |

## Effect

A positive figure raises the early-pay rate and a negative one lowers it, in percentage points. For a hypothetical early-pay rate of 1 percent: a remittance reference carrying WIRE makes it 1.25 percent; one carrying CHK only makes it 0.75 percent. On a program whose early-pay discount percent is 0, the invoice earns no discount, whatever is added to the early-pay rate.
